source_title: Corporate interior - Endless Illusion Mirror Wall
desc_src: A prototype of the innovative lightbox that creates the illusion of lights, and many objects, going off into infinity in two planes at once. The mirrored box is only 2" deep. Applications for inset wall panels at the ends of corridors or lobbies are intriguing! Designed with Jonathan Cutler, AIA.
